user.title: Pando account
user.description: Enter your Pando app credentials. MQTT normally verifies the server certificate. The optional SHA-256 fingerprint trusts exactly one certificate, including if it is expired. Obtain and verify it separately; a certificate change will stop the connection. HTTPS always uses normal validation.
